info.title: API.SH: Pinterest
info.description: The Pinterest API from API.SH: public Pinterest data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description: Newest first. Filter by status, route prefix, key or time; page with `before` (the `next` value). Add output=csv|ndjson to download (up to 5,000 rows per request; the next cursor is in the x-next-cursor header). Free.

get.description: The exact response a call returned, for 30 days after the call, at no cost. Use the call's x-request-id. Supports output=csv|ndjson.

get.description:

parameters.description: Most suggestions (1-20, default 10).

get.description:
A Pinterest ideas topic page (the ideas hub of an interest): name, description, followers, monthly searches, breadcrumbs, related topics, sub-topics, trending searches and related boards, with the topic's pins (id, title, description, image, link, saves, creator). Pass next_cursor back as cursor for more pins.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/pinterest-topic

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A pinterest.com/ideas/<name>/<id>/ link, or pass id.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The topic's numeric id (the number in its ideas link), instead of url.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: next_cursor from the previous page for more pins.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Pinterest Trends: the top or fastest-growing search terms on Pinterest in a country or region, with week-over-week, month-over-month and year-over-year growth, a 0-100 search index and a seasonality score. Filter by interest and by keywords to include or exclude; `history=1` adds each term's weekly search interest for the past year.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/pinterest-trends

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: ISO country code (US, GB, DE, FR, BR, JP, ...) or a region Pinterest groups, such as GB+IE, DE+AT+CH or AU+NZ. Default US.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: monthly (top this month, default), yearly (top this year), growing (fastest growing) or seasonal.

parameters.name: interest
parameters.description: Up to 5 comma-separated interests: animals, architecture, art, beauty, design, diy_and_crafts, education, electronics, entertainment, event_planning, finance, food_and_drink, health, home_decor, lawn_and_garden, parenting, quotes, sports, travel, vehicles, weddings, womens_fashion, mens_fashion, kids_fashion (or a numeric interest id).

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: Comma-separated keywords every term must contain (up to 20).

parameters.name: exclude
parameters.description: Comma-separated keywords to leave out (up to 20).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Terms to return, 1-100 (default 50).

parameters.name: end_date
parameters.description: YYYY-MM-DD; default the latest date Pinterest has data for.

parameters.name: history
parameters.description: 1 to add each term's weekly search interest for the past year.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Weekly search interest on Pinterest for up to 10 terms (0-100, normalized per term), with week, month and year growth. When Pinterest has not served the latest week for every asked term yet, the newest series held for those terms is returned with `stale: true` (its `end_date` is the series end; `latest_end_date` is the newest week Pinterest lists). Pinterest limits this data for short periods: a term not asked recently can take up to about two minutes, and a 503 means the terms were queued; retry within about 5 minutes (5xx answers are not charged).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/pinterest-trends-keyword

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: One or more comma-separated terms (up to 10).

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: ISO country code or a Pinterest region such as GB+IE. Default US.

parameters.name: days
parameters.description: Window: 30, 90, 180, 365 (default) or 730 days.

parameters.name: end_date
parameters.description: YYYY-MM-DD; default the latest date Pinterest has data for.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
